# SOP-P3-L3-04 Shift handover - Machining line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

Purpose
This procedure defines the required activities, checks, and records for shift handover on the Machining line to ensure continuity of safe operation and traceability of actions when responsibility transfers between operators.

Scope
Applies to all operators, maintenance personnel, and supervisors responsible for EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03 on plant P3, line P3-L3.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-016
- SOP-P3-L3-01
- SOP-P3-L3-03

Background and rationale
Handover is a critical control for process safety and quality. Clear, consistent transfer of information prevents unintended machine states, missed maintenance actions, and production losses. This procedure aligns with line operating rules and preserves the asset condition of EQ-P3-L3-HP03 by ensuring hydraulic parameters and fasteners are verified within engineering limits before the receiving operator assumes control.

Key engineering limits to verify during handover
- The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Confirm pressure indicators and records reflect operation within this limit.
- The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Confirm torque verification has been completed and documented where required.

Preconditions
1. Incoming operator and outgoing operator are present and available for the handover discussion at the machine or control station.
2. Any open maintenance permits affecting the equipment are visible and available for review.
3. Control system logs and last-shift production and maintenance notes are accessible.

Required personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Safety glasses
2. Hearing protection
3. Safety footwear
4. Cut-resistant gloves (for handling tooling and fasteners)
5. High-visibility vest

Procedure - numbered steps
1. Initial location and introductions
   - Outgoing operator meets incoming operator at the designated handover point for the machine group.
   - Confirm names and roles for the shift-to-shift record.

2. Status overview
   - Outgoing operator provides a concise verbal summary of current line status covering production run, part program, tooling condition, and any abnormal events.
   - Highlight any incomplete tasks or deferred actions tied to SOP-P3-L3-01 or SOP-P3-L3-03.

3. Safety and lockout checks
   - Review any active lockout/tagout or maintenance permits. Confirm permits will be carried forward if unresolved.
   - Verify that safety interlocks and guards on EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03 are in place and functional.

4. Hydraulic press verification (EQ-P3-L3-HP03)
   - Review last recorded system pressure and compare with the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar.
   - Confirm any pressure deviations were addressed and that corrective actions are documented.
   - Review torque verification records for the main ram bolt where the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Confirm evidence of verification is attached to the equipment maintenance log if required.

5. Tooling and consumables
   - Inspect tooling condition and confirm tool change status. Note any tool life concerns or pending replacements.
   - Confirm availability of critical consumables and that pick lists or requests are raised per procedures.

6. Control system and program state
   - Confirm active program or recipe and any parameters modified during the outgoing shift.
   - If abnormal parameter changes were made, document the reason and location in the log, and reference ECN-2026-016 if program changes are persistent.

7. Quality and inspection feedback
   - Review last inspected parts, any rejects, and corrective actions taken. Attach measurement records and traceability tags to the shift record.

8. Maintenance and defect reporting
   - Review outstanding defect reports and the status of corrective maintenance. Ensure priority items are clearly communicated.
   - If maintenance included torque checks or hydraulic interventions, ensure the receiving operator has the verification certificate or maintenance entry.

9. Examples of specific handover statements
   - "EQ-P3-L3-HP03 pressure nominal per last read; refer to pressure log and note that the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar."
   - "Main ram bolt torque verified; see maintenance log where the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m."

10. Documentation and sign-off
   - Both operators complete the shift handover form, noting any follow-up actions and attaching relevant logs or permits.
   - Outgoing operator initials the action items and incoming operator accepts responsibility by initialing the form.

Records to keep
1. Completed shift handover form with signatures and attachments.
2. Equipment logs for EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03 including pressure and torque verification entries.
3. Any maintenance permits or defect reports carried forward.
4. Quality inspection records and run reports referenced during handover.

Rationale for record retention
Maintaining these records ensures traceability for quality investigations, maintenance audits, and safety reviews. Linking changes to ECN-2026-016 and operational directives in SOP-P3-L3-01 and SOP-P3-L3-03 avoids undocumented deviations and supports root cause analysis.

Common issues and mitigations
- Incomplete handover notes: Use the handover form checklist to force completion of critical items.
- Missing verification evidence: Do not accept handover until key verifications for pressure and critical fasteners are present.
- Ambiguous responsibility: Insist on simultaneous presence of both operators during sign-off.

Sign-off
Outgoing operator name / signature / time  
Incoming operator name / signature / time  
Supervisor name / signature / time

References
- ECN-2026-016
- SOP-P3-L3-01
- SOP-P3-L3-03

Revision history
Rev B — Current: updated to include explicit verification steps for EQ-P3-L3-HP03 pressure and main ram bolt torque per maintenance instruction set.
